findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_cold_email_personalizer, ai_web_extractor, ai_website_audit, b2b_competitor_monitor, competitor_pulse, reddit_insights, universal_review_insights, website_to_markdown, amazon_reviews_scraper, etsy_scraper, ai_seo_site_auditor, youtube_transcript_scraper · Private data: ai_company_enrichment, company_due_diligence, cve_vulnerability_lookup, email_finder_scraper, osm_local_business_finder, google_news_scraper, youtube_transcript_scraper · Public sink: ai_search_visibility_platform, ai_cold_email_personalizer, ai_share_of_voice, ai_social_listening, ai_brand_visibility, ai_prospecting_pipeline, b2b_cold_outreach_sequencer, b2b_intent_radar, b2b_outbound_engine, email_finder_scraper · Destructive: b2b_outbound_engine.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
